# WellValet

> Canadian grocery barcode scanner. Scan any food or personal care product for
> personalised wellness scores, allergen alerts and full ingredient analysis.
> Built by Ecosystem & AnalytiX International Ltd., Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

## What it does
- Scans grocery and beauty product barcodes for instant ingredient breakdown
- Flags allergens against the user's own declared allergy profile
- Produces an A-D wellness score personalised to the individual, not a population average
- Covers Canadian grocery products via the Open Food Facts database

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.wellvalet.com/): product overview and features
- [WellValet vs Yuka](https://www.wellvalet.com/yuka-alternative-canada.html): comparison for Canadian shoppers
- [Allergen scanner](https://www.wellvalet.com/allergen-scanner-app.html): how allergen detection works
- [Resources](https://www.wellvalet.com/resources.html): guides on Canadian grocery labels
- [Support](https://www.wellvalet.com/support.html): frequently asked questions
- [About](https://www.wellvalet.com/about.html): company information

## Availability
Free tier: 3 scans per day. Premium from C$5.99/month. Family plan available.
iOS and Android. Canada.

## Note
WellValet provides general wellness information, not medical advice.
Ingredient data is community-sourced and incomplete for some products.
Users should always read the physical product label for allergen information.
